thread:
Iris (Sales Eng): Petal Analytics sent an RFI. They want a 10-day POC in their US VPC, baseline 2 GPUs, burst to 6, SOC2 evidence, KMIP HSM option, and a capability matrix mapped to their controls. Need non-binding pricing + short infra snippet by EOD.

Jon (AE): Copy. Do they require customer-managed certs for mTLS? Also ask if audit logging needs to be retained >90 days.

Iris (Sales Eng): They said optional customer certs and audit retention "up to 90 days" but want that configurable. Include that in RFI answers.

Tariq (SRE): We can spin a private POC in ~36-48h for basic peering + 2-node (1 GPU each) then scale. KMIP/HSM adds ~7 days + SOW. Minimal bootstrap for their infra team:
```bash
# on Petal bastion
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env petal-poc --cidr 10.60.0.0/22
```
I'll need contact email and CIDR.

Nina (Solutions): Uploaded petal_matrix_v1.xlsx and petal_rfi_answers_v1.pdf to shared drive. Matrix highlights: model catalog, quantization options, KV prefix caching, routing fallback tiers, and observability hooks. Will attach SOC2 (redacted).

Jon (AE): Pricing proposal: offer 50% off compute for 10-day POC and waive onboarding. Tariq, ballpark numbers for the quote?

Tariq (SRE): Non-binding ballpark: baseline 2xA100-eq ~ $9k/month committed; burst ~$16/GPU-hr; egress ~$0.09/GB. With 50% promo for 10 days estimate ~$650-$1.4k depending on burst. KMIP/HSM integration and extended audit retention are extra.

security-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) attached per request.

Iris (Sales Eng): Great. I'll draft the reply to petal@petal.ai including Nina's attachments, the snippet, and the non-binding quote. Jon, please approve the promo.

Jon (AE): Approved. Send and note trial limits: 10 days, max burst 6 GPUs, support at trial tier.
